inputs.share_count_basis: 1,452.0M fully diluted weighted-average count from the Q3 2026 10-Q (Note I; the $2.0B ASR settled 12 June 2026, so the Q3 average is a clean post-buyback count; cover-page basic count 1,449.5M at 29 Oct 2026) PLUS ~40.5M shares expected to be issued to Penumbra holders at the early-2027 close (genuine non-SBC issuance: acquisition currency; ~27% of ~38.8M Penumbra shares x 3.8721 exchange ratio, per the deal terms summarised in BSX_Analysis.json -- an estimate, the proration mechanics are not in the filings held in this folder). Held FLAT thereafter because SBC is fully expensed in owner FCF.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 10-K cash-flow statement, ShareBasedCompensation add-back ($299M), which is the company's own combined P&L SBC expense figure; BSX does not separately disclose cash taxes withheld on net-share settlement in a distinct XBRL tag post-2015, so no further addition was made to avoid double-counting an unquantified amount. 9M-2026 SBC was $242M (1.53% of revenue), which anchors year 1 of the forward path.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Unchanged from the 2026-09-26 build. Large-cap, investment-grade US medtech; risk-free ~4.2% (10yr UST), ERP ~5%, beta ~1.0-1.1 -> cost of equity ~9.3%; blended with debt at an after-tax cost of ~3.5% gives WACC ~8.5%. The Penumbra financing roughly doubles net debt, which raises the debt weight and the cost of equity together; the two were judged to offset, so the rate was not moved. The per-scenario WACC spread (8.0/8.5/9.5) is a prior judgment left in place.
inputs.lease_treatment: not material -- BSX's balance sheet does not carry a separately disclosed operating-lease liability large enough to change net debt; no lease adjustment applied
inputs.nci_treatment: not applicable -- no material minority interest reported
inputs.notes: UPDATE of the 2026-09-26 build (see reconciliation). Routed via .claude/skills/dcf-methods/SKILL.md: profitable, diversified US operating company (medical devices) -> standard owner-FCF DCF, scenario-weighted, 10-year explicit horizon because the owner-FCF margin is still below its projected mature level. Interest-income strip does NOT apply: BSX carries net debt. PENUMBRA IS MODELLED PRO FORMA in all three scenarios: stockholders approved on 6 May 2026, financing is committed ($6.0B delayed-draw term loans + $2.0B 364-day revolver, undrawn at 30 Sep 2026) and the Q3 10-Q guides to an early-2027 close, with the FTC Second Request (16 Mar 2026) the one open condition. The ~$11.0B cash consideration is deducted in equity_bridge (net_debt stays the reported 30 Sep 2026 figure), ~40.5M new shares are in the share count, and Penumbra's revenue (~$1.3B for a part-year 2027, ~$2.0B in 2028), its lower EBITDA margin and its heavier SBC are blended into the driver paths from year 2. Penumbra's own net cash is NOT credited because it could not be verified from the filings in this folder; that omission is conservative by an unquantified but small amount (well under $1/share). If the FTC blocks the deal the modelled value is HIGHER, not lower: the same drivers ex-Penumbra (the standalone-equivalent paths in each growth_rates_note, 1,452.0M shares, no cash outflow) give a weighted value of 38.42 against 34.12 pro forma, so the model reads the deal as costing about $4.30/share at the announced terms -- $11.0B of cash and ~40.5M shares for a business the driver paths value at roughly $6B. Buybacks: $2.0B ASR in Q2 2026 (about 40M shares at ~$50), $3.0B authorisation remaining; none assumed while the deal is funded. Leverage: pro forma gross debt is roughly 4x EBITDA against a 3.75x covenant that steps up after a qualified acquisition; no covenant stress is modelled, but it is why no further buyback is assumed. Price is a regular-session close, not an after-hours print.

equity_bridge.note: FY2025 10-K: cash on hand plus newly issued debt of ~$11.0B in aggregate; the balance of the ~$14.5B announced price is paid in BSX shares, which are in shares_outstanding. Penumbra's acquired net cash is not credited (unverified).

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Revenue (15.2%), FCF (28.4%) and EPS (63.3%, off a near-zero FY2020 base) 5yr/3yr CAGRs are far above the 5yr equity CAGR of 9.8%, driven by a structural EBITDA-margin expansion (10.5% in FY2020 to 24.8% in FY2025) as the company scaled Farapulse/WATCHMAN and absorbed prior-year one-offs (FY2020 was a COVID-depressed trough with a net loss). Equity CAGR is used as the conservative anchor for historical context, but the forward base case does not extrapolate the FY2022-2025 owner-FCF CAGR (67%) -- that period captured a one-time margin inflection that is not repeatable; forward growth is anchored to FY2026 guidance and management's flat FY2027 framing.
historical_growth.notes: Unchanged from the prior build: FY0 is still FY2025, the last full year. SBC-adjusted (owner) FCF grew from $962M (FY2020) to $3,359M (FY2025), a 5yr CAGR of 28.4% -- faster than revenue's 15.2%, reflecting margin expansion rather than SBC growing faster than cash flow (SBC grew from $170M to $299M, roughly in line with revenue).

base.growth_rates_note: Y1 FY2026 = guidance (~4.25% reported; 9M actual $15,784M plus Q4 guided -1% to -3%). Y2 FY2027 = flat organic per management's 'trough' framing + ~$1.3B of part-year Penumbra revenue. Y3 FY2028 = 4.3% organic recovery (FARAWAVE Ultra early 2028) + Penumbra annualising. Standalone-equivalent path: 4.3, 0.0, 4.3, 5.5, 5.6, 5.0, 4.5, 4.0, 3.5, 3.0; years 6-10 organic are the prior build's, unchanged.
base.ebitda_margin_path_note: Y1 unchanged at 25.5%: 9M-2026 GAAP EBITDA was 26.4% and Q4 is guided weak. FY2027 dips on flat sales, China VBP price and Penumbra (lower-margin, plus integration cost); the 27.5% plateau is unchanged but reached two years later than in the prior build.
base.narrative: FY2026 lands on the twice-cut guide (~4.3% growth). FY2027 is the trough management describes: flat organic sales with no WATCHMAN recovery, further China VBP price cuts in Endoscopy and no electrophysiology re-acceleration until FARAWAVE Ultra, so all of the year's reported growth is part-year Penumbra. Organic growth recovers to 4-5.5% in FY2028-30 on FARAWAVE Ultra, FARAFLEX, TAVR/IVL and renal denervation, with Penumbra's thrombectomy franchise compounding at 10-12% on top, before the blend decelerates to a 3% terminal rate. EBITDA margin dips to 24.8% in FY2027 and climbs to a 27.5% plateau by FY2032 as the ~$500M restructuring programme and deal synergies offset PFA/WATCHMAN pricing pressure.

bull.growth_rates_note: Standalone-equivalent path: 4.6, 2.0, 6.5, 8.0, 7.5, 7.0, 6.0, 5.0, 4.0, 3.5 -- the prior bull path with FY2026-28 pulled down to the guide and the trough; Penumbra adds ~6.6pp in FY2027 and ~3pp in FY2028.
bull.narrative: The 2027 'trough' proves to be a conservative reset after two misses: the cyberattack hangover clears by Q1 2027, WATCHMAN FLX Pro and FARAWATCH concomitant procedures stabilise LAAC, and organic sales grow ~2% rather than zero. FARAWAVE Ultra restores Farapulse's lead in 2028 and the PFA category keeps expanding, taking organic growth back to 6.5-8%. Penumbra closes on schedule, its CAVT thrombectomy franchise grows mid-teens through BSX's global channel and the deal turns accretive in year two. Restructuring savings and synergies arrive ahead of plan and lift EBITDA margin to 30.5%.

bear.growth_rates_note: Standalone-equivalent path: 4.1, -2.0, 0.5, 2.5, 3.0, 3.0, 2.8, 2.5, 2.5, 2.5. Y1 is now largely actual (the prior 1.0% assumed a far worse cyberattack hit than the 9M print and Q4 guide show); FY2027-28 are cut instead. Penumbra adds ~6pp in FY2027 and ~2.3pp in FY2028, growing only mid-single digits thereafter.
bear.narrative: 2027 is not the trough but the first year of organic decline: WATCHMAN standalone volumes keep shrinking after OCEAN/CHAMPION-AF, Medtronic, J&J, Abbott and Kardium keep taking PFA share in an ~80-85%-penetrated US market, FARAWAVE Ultra slips or fails to differentiate, and China VBP spreads beyond Endoscopy and Urology. Organic sales fall ~2% in FY2027 and barely recover. Penumbra closes at the announced price but underdelivers -- thrombectomy growth slows to mid-single digits, integration distracts a stretched organisation, and ~$11B of new debt taken on at the top of the leverage range leaves no room for buybacks. Restructuring charges run ahead of savings and EBITDA margin settles at 24.5%, three points below the base case.

scenario_narratives.base: FY2026 on the twice-cut guide (~4.3%); FY2027 the flat-organic trough management describes, with all reported growth coming from part-year Penumbra; organic recovery to 4-5.5% from FY2028 on FARAWAVE Ultra, FARAFLEX, TAVR/IVL and renal denervation, Penumbra compounding at 10-12% on top. EBITDA margin dips to 24.8% in FY2027 and reaches a 27.5% plateau by FY2032.
scenario_narratives.bull: The trough guide proves a conservative reset: organic growth ~2% in FY2027, FARAWAVE Ultra restores the PFA lead in 2028, WATCHMAN stabilises on FLX Pro/FARAWATCH, Penumbra grows mid-teens and turns accretive in year two, and restructuring plus synergies take EBITDA margin to 30.5%.
scenario_narratives.bear: FY2027 is the first year of organic decline, not the trough: WATCHMAN keeps shrinking, PFA share losses continue, FARAWAVE Ultra disappoints, China VBP widens, and Penumbra underdelivers while ~$11B of new debt removes balance-sheet flexibility. EBITDA margin settles at 24.5%.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Unchanged at 25/50/25. Bear stays at 25% (house default 15%): the second guidance cut and the flat-2027 framing that motivated the higher weight in September have now happened and are in the base path, but they are replaced by a new, comparable risk -- a ~$14.5B acquisition priced when the shares were more than twice today's level, funded with ~$11B of debt and closing into the trough year. Base stays at 50% because the balance sheet remains investment-grade with committed financing and the company is still the volume leader in LAAC and PFA. Bull stays at 25% (default 35%) because it needs several independent things to go right at once: the 2027 guide to prove conservative, FARAWAVE Ultra to land on time and differentiated, and Penumbra to integrate cleanly.

unchanged_assumptions.statement: Deliberately left as in the 2026-09-26 build; each is an asserted finding, not an omission.

items.would_move_on: a credit-rating downgrade on the Penumbra financing, or the new notes pricing materially wide of the existing ~2.8% pretax cost of debt
FTC clearance with no remedies and a first clean quarter after the cyberattack (bear down); a third guidance cut or an FY2027 guide below flat in February 2027 (bear up)
FY2026 10-K: 9M-2026 was 26.4%, so a Q4 below ~22% would be needed to miss it
evidence that the Penumbra intangibles are tax-deductible; in a stock acquisition they are not, so the acquired amortisation gives no cash-tax shield and was not added
FY2026 capex well below ~4.3% of revenue (9M-2026 ran at 3.5% but Q4 is seasonally heavy), or inventory build to de-risk supply after the cyberattack
Pillar Two safe-harbour legislation, or expiry of the Costa Rica free-trade-zone incentives (2028-2034) without renewal

items.assumption: Base organic growth in years 6-10 (5.0, 4.5, 4.0, 3.5, 3.0) and the 27.5% margin plateau
items.would_move_on: FARAWAVE Ultra / FARAFLEX clinical and launch data in 2028-29; WATCHMAN volumes after the OCEAN/CHAMPION-AF guideline cycle

items.assumption: Owner-FCF base (FY2025 reported FCF $3,658M less SBC $299M) and historical CAGRs
items.would_move_on: the FY2026 10-K, which rolls FY0 forward

valuation_philosophy.summary: Boston Scientific is a diversified medtech franchise (Farapulse PFA, WATCHMAN LAAC, TAVR/IVL, endoscopy, urology) whose two highest-profile growth engines stalled in 2026 and whose management now calls 2027 the trough: flat organic sales, no WATCHMAN recovery, China VBP price cuts, and no electrophysiology catalyst until 2028. Into that it is closing its largest deal in twenty years. The valuation therefore treats Penumbra as done -- cash out, shares issued, revenue and lower margin blended in -- rather than as an option, and lets the numbers say what the deal is worth: at the announced terms the model reads it as costing about $4.30 a share against the standalone business, because ~$11B of cash and ~40M shares buy a ~$2B-revenue business whose owner cash flow does not cover the price at an 8.5% discount rate. The core franchise is not impaired -- it remains investment-grade, the volume leader in its categories, with a credible $500M cost programme -- but the market price sits above both the house value and the street (SBC-add-back) value in the weighted case, so the stock is not yet paying the owner for the leverage and execution risk now attached to it. Only the bull case clears the current price.
key_risks_to_valuation: Penumbra: FTC Second Request still open; a block would RAISE the modelled value (standalone 38.42 weighted vs 34.12 pro forma), while a close at the announced terms into weaker thrombectomy growth is the bear path

Penumbra inputs (revenue ~$2.0B in FY2028, EBITDA margin in the high teens rising with synergies, ~40.5M shares issued, acquired net cash ignored) are estimates -- none of Penumbra's own filings are held in this folder
FY2027 guidance is so far only a verbal 'roughly flat, ex-Penumbra' framing from the Q3 call; the formal guide arrives with Q4 results in early 2027 and could sit either side of it
WATCHMAN standalone deceleration may be a durable shift in referral patterns (OCEAN/CHAMPION-AF); management assumes no recovery in 2027
PFA is ~80-85% penetrated in the US with Medtronic, J&J, Abbott and Kardium gaining share; the next differentiated BSX catheter is not due until early 2028
Pro forma gross leverage of roughly 4x EBITDA going into a trough year removes buyback capacity and leaves less room for a third miss
Restructuring plan ($700-800M pre-tax charges, $600-700M cash through 2029) is carried inside the EBITDA margin path rather than itemised
Terminal value binds at the cap multiple in base and bull, so those values are more sensitive to the terminal-year margin than to terminal growth
